It can be scooped with an empty [[Bottle]] from bodies of water. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Water|Water|Series, TWW, TWWHD, TMC, TP, TPHD, SS}} | {{List| * {{TWW}} * {{TWWHD}} * {{TMC}} * {{TP}} * {{TPHD}} * {{SS}} * {{SSHD}} }} |- | {{Term/Store|Spring Water|Spring Water|MM, MM3D}} | {{List| * {{MM}} * {{MM3D}} }} |- | {{Term/Store|Bottled Water|Bottled Water|HWL, HWDE}} | {{List| * {{HWL}}{{Name Ref|HWL}} * {{HWDE}} }} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{MM|-}}=== Bottled Spring Water can be poured on [[Magic Bean]]s to make them grow once they are planted in soft [[Soil]] in {{MM}}. If [[Link]] lets [[Hot Spring Water]] cool, it will turn into plain Spring Water. ==={{TWW|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= TWW |type= Characters |category= Items in The Wind Waker |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where they are found * How much they cost * What they do }} Bottled Water must be used to restore the withered [[Bomb Flower]]s in [[Dragon Roost Island]] in order to enter the [[Dragon Roost Cavern]] in {{TWW}}. ==={{TMC|-}}=== Bottled Water must be used on sprouting beanstalk seeds at [[Mount Crenel]] in order for them to grow, allowing Link to climb them in {{TMC}}. Water can also be poured on fireplaces in [[Hyrule Town]] in order for Link to enter them while in [[Minish]] size. ==={{TP|-}}=== Bottled Water can be poured on [[Ordon Pumpkin|Pumpkin]]s found at [[Ordon Village]] to make them grow in {{TP}}. It can also be poured on small [[Fire]]s to extinguish them. ==={{SS|-}}=== Bottled Water must be poured on the [[Thirsty Frog]]s found at the entrance to the [[Fire Sanctuary (Dungeon)|Fire Sanctuary]] in {{SS}}. Doing so extinguishes the [[Flame Wall]]s blocking the path forward. ==Other Appearances== ==={{FPTRR|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|FPTRR}} [[File:FPTRR Water Sprite.png|left]] Water can be gathered from various sources. It is mainly used for dousing [[Enemy|Enemies]] that are on [[Fire]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{HWL|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} [[File:HWDE Bottled Water Food Icon.png|64px|left]] In {{HWL}}, Bottled Water appears as a Drink-type [[Food#Hyrule Warriors|Food]]. It is imbued with the Water [[Element]]. When consumed by a [[Companion Fairy]] in the [[Dining Room]] of the [[My Fairy]] mode, Bottled Water can increase the Fairy's Trust level and personality traits. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== *In {{MM|-}}, both regular Spring Water and Hot Spring Water can be used to remove [[Sun Block]]s. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ===Other Names=== {{Other Names |- | Springwater | {{MM}} | [[Zelda.com]] | {{E}} }} ==Gallery== File:TPHD Link Pouring Water.jpg|{{Game Label|{{TPHD|-}}}}Link pouring Water on some Pumpkins File:HWL Bottled Water Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{HWL|-}}}}Icon of Bottled Water ==See Also== {{See Also| * Ice * Sage of Water * Water Temple }} {{Ref| {{Cite Book|quote= |book= E |publisher= |page= 142 {{Exp Game|MM, MM3D, TWW, TWWHD, TMC, TP, TPHD, SS}}}} {{Cite|Your Hot Spring Water cooled.
